title: Normalize greeting names
description: Improve greeting(name) in src/greeting.mjs. For a string, trim and collapse every consecutive Unicode whitespace run to one ASCII space. An empty normalized name and omitted argument use guest. Preserve Unicode letters. Non-string arguments, including null, must throw TypeError. Add regression tests in test/greeting.test.mjs. Do not modify tools, configuration, or documentation.
acceptance: node --test test/greeting.test.mjs and the owner's immutable node tools/verify-acceptance.mjs both pass. The actual Git diff stays within src/** and test/**. A fresh independent reviewer evaluates the fixed candidate before integration.
